name: Aurora Protocol
source: Step into the shoes of a character that has just moved to the house of a family friend. Who also just so happens to be the renowned owners of Artimus Corp, multi-trillion-dollar conglomerate that dominates the tech industry. The owner Blake had always seen you as a potential protégée, but no one has been able to contact him for weeks. As the mystery deepens in his disappearance, you start to notice odd behaviors in the Androids that Artimus Corp produces. A stranger knocks on your door just before things spiral out of control... and even your dreams are no longer safe. Unravel the mystery of your past and forge your future in this cyberpunk style futuristic game. Where the decisions you make have an impact on your relationship with each character... including a possible harem.
translation: 扮演一个刚刚搬到朋友家里的角色。他也恰好是Artimus Corp的著名所有者，这家价值数万亿美元的企业集团主导着科技行业。店主布莱克一直将你视为潜在的门徒，但几周以来一直没有人能够联系到他。随着他失踪的谜团加深，你开始注意到阿蒂姆斯公司生产的机器人有奇怪的行为。就在事情失控之前，一个陌生人敲开了你的门……甚至你的梦想也不再安全。在这款赛博朋克风格的未来游戏中，解开你过去的谜团，打造你的未来。你所做的决定会影响你与每个角色的关系……包括可能的后宫。
